menu.tagline: Design, launch and operate your mission

settings.title: Settings
settings.accessible2DHint: Do the whole design from 2D panels, without moving in 3D.
settings.mascotHint: Comments and help with H. Turn it off if you already know the game.
settings.soundCaptionsHint: Shows text such as [battery alarm] when a warning sounds. Important warnings always flash on screen.

credits.walker: Hangar exhibit and lunar and Mars exploration rover

hangar.title: Integration hangar
hangar.noStructure: No structure: mount a bus first.
hangar.capture: Click the scene to capture the mouse

prompt.shipEmpty: The spacecraft is empty: bring a component

review.title: Go/No-Go review
review.nogoText: There are blockers to resolve before launch.

report.title: Mission report
report.preLaunchSummary: Before launch: {{months}}-month delay and {{pct}}% budget cut.

help.title: Controls
help.menu: Choose Play to start. Change the language at the top.
help.briefing: Read the requirements and press "Go to the hangar".
help.hangar: WASD move · mouse look · V switch 1st/3rd person · E interact (pick up, mount, console) · Q put back · Tab resource panel · Esc release mouse · H help
help.review: Review the findings. With Go you can authorize the launch.
help.launch: V toggles chase camera and tower view · H help
help.operation: V toggles orbital camera and view through the instrument · I opens the main instrument view · drag to orbit the camera · use the time controls · H help
help.report: Review the chain of causes and redesign.
help.lobby: Wait for your team and pick your role. The host starts the mission once all four roles are covered. H help · G glossary
help.team: In a room: T chat · R requests · P mark (in the hangar, look at a part or a spot) · the top bar shows your roles and the connection.

errors.modelFallback: A 3D model could not be loaded; a simple shape is shown.

scenarios.title: Choose a mission
scenarios.intro: Each scenario asks for different things: compare type, difficulty and budget before you start.
scenarios.empty: There are no campaign scenarios in the catalog.

academy.completedText: You now know every resource. Try a campaign mission.

wait.hangar: Go on to the hangar for this step.
wait.operation: Request the Go/No-Go review and launch to continue.
wait.report: Finish operations to see the report.
wait.launch: Request the Go/No-Go review and authorize the launch: this step happens on the pad.

goal.go: get a Go at the review.

academy.incompleteText: You skipped some steps. Enter the Academy again and complete them to pass it.
academy.reviewLocked: Not yet: finish the Academy steps before requesting the Go/No-Go review.

advisors.title: Team advisors
advisors.none: No advice yet: mount some parts.

prelaunch.title: Before launch
prelaunch.intro: The review gave a Go, but the real world does not wait: these surprises affect your mission.
prelaunch.overrun: Now exceeded: {{list}}. It does not cancel the mission, but it lowers the score.

hint.nominal: The instrument points well and there is light: every pass adds useful data.
hint.eclipse: Earth blocks the Sun: without light the sensor sees nothing and the craft lives on its battery.
hint.degraded: A reaction wheel or the attitude unit failed: pointing gets worse and the image turns blurry and shaky.
hint.lost: No more images are coming in. Check the event log to see what failed.
hint.noInstrument: Your design carries no instruments: there is nothing to look at.

lost.mission: NO SIGNAL: MISSION ENDED IN FAILURE

surface.description: A short look at the Aurora G9 rover walking across the terrain. Its data already counts in the mission panel.

status.reconnecting: Connection to the room was lost. Reconnecting…
status.reconnected: Connection restored: you are still in the room.

error.notFound: There is no open room with that code.
error.rejected: The room is full or the mission has already started.
error.unreachable: Could not reach the game server. Check your connection.
error.resume: Could not return to the previous room.
error.lost: The connection to the room was lost. You are back at the menu.
error.closed: The room was closed. You are back at the menu.
error.server: The room server reported an error.
error.academyScenario: The Academy is for one person only: pick a campaign mission.
error.invalidAttempt: The room attempt is not valid.
error.invalidSeed: The room seed is not valid.
error.roomNotInLobby: That room's mission has already started: you can only join while it is in the waiting room.
error.alreadyJoined: You are already in that room.
error.locked: The room is full or the mission has already started: ask the host for a new code.

notice.requestCreated: A request was sent to the responsible role: wait for their answer.

entry.title: Play as a team
entry.intro: Up to 4 people design and operate a mission together, each with a role. Create a private room and share the code, join with a code, or look for a quick match.

lobby.title: Waiting room
lobby.shareHint: Share this code so your team can join.
lobby.combineHint: With fewer than 4 players, roles are combined: one person can take several.
lobby.rolesIntro: Each role decides on one part of the mission and watches certain resources. Claim yours.
lobby.waitHost: Waiting for the host to start the mission.

director.decides: Decides the orbit and launcher, splits the budget, confirms the launch and ends the operation. Resolves budget and time requests.

engineering.decides: Mounts structure, power, batteries, computer, attitude control and thermal. Resolves mass, power and battery requests.

science.decides: Chooses the payload instruments: what the mission is there to measure. Asks the other roles for resources when needed.

operations.decides: Mounts communications and controls operation time. Resolves data, communications and lifetime requests.

requests.title: Requests
requests.intro: When something you ask for affects another role's resource, that person decides. The whole team sees every request.
requests.badAmount: The amount must be a number greater than 0.
requests.cooldown: You just sent a request: wait a moment before asking for another.

budget.title: Budget
budget.introEdit: Split the money for parts across subsystems. A part that goes over its share will ask for your approval.
budget.introRead: Budget split by subsystem. The Flight Director decides it.

pings.title: Mark
pings.intro: Point something out to the team. In the hangar, look at a part or a spot and press P.

alerts.title: Team alert
alerts.timeout: The alert closes by itself after {{s}} s

vote.title: Go/No-Go vote
vote.noRole: You have no role: you cannot vote.
vote.reasonHint: A No-Go needs a reason so the team knows what to fix.

error.code: Pick a reason for the No-Go.
error.note: With "other reason" you must write a note.

lastNoGo.vote: The team voted No-Go. These are the reasons:
lastNoGo.review: The technical review said No-Go. This needs fixing:

report.title: Team collaboration
report.why: Collaboration measures how fast the team resolved requests and alerts: coordinating well weighs as much as designing well, because in a real mission nobody decides alone.
report.onlyDirector: Only the Flight Director can redesign

prelaunch.waiting: Waiting for {{role}} to confirm the launch.

operation.timeLocked: Time is controlled by Director and Operations. Current speed: {{accel}}
operation.onlyDirector: Only the Flight Director ends the operation

leaveConfirm.title: Leave the room?
leaveConfirm.body: The mission has already started: if you leave you cannot rejoin this room and your roles will pass to the rest of the team.

retry.title: Connection lost
retry.body: Your place in the room is kept for {{seconds}} s more.
retry.expired: Time is up to return to the room.
